test_cases_present: partial - the spec provides functional descriptions, register definitions, and timing waveforms that map to compliance test scenarios but does not provide a formal test plan or testbench.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Master Reset behavior — all registers (except RBR/THR/DLL/DLM) reset; SOUT/INTR/OUT1/OUT2/RTS/DTR per Table I.
Character mode (16450 mode) TX + RX with each combination of (5/6/7/8 data bits) × (no/even/odd/mark/space parity) × (1/1.5/2 stop bits).
Baud rate divisor sweep — DLL/DLM = 1, 2, 3, ..., 65535.
False start-bit detection — short LOW pulse on SIN does NOT start reception.
Mid-bit sampling robustness — receiver tolerates ± n% clock-skew.
Framing Error — stop bit forced LOW; LSR.FE set.
Parity Error — flip parity bit; LSR.PE set.
Overrun Error — new character arrives before previous is read; LSR.OE set.
Break Interrupt — SIN LOW for > 1 character time; LSR.BI set.
Line break transmission — LCR.BREAK=1 forces SOUT LOW continuously.
FIFO mode entry / exit — FCR0 transitions.
RX FIFO trigger interrupt at each of {1, 4, 8, 14} byte thresholds.
RX FIFO character timeout — 4-char-time silence triggers interrupt.
TX FIFO underflow recovery — push then drain.
FIFO reset — FCR.RX_FIFO_RESET / FCR.TX_FIFO_RESET self-clearing.
Loopback diagnostic — MCR.LOOP=1; SOUT→SIN; modem outputs → modem inputs.
MODEM Status delta bits (DCTS / DDSR / TERI / DDCD) — toggle inputs and verify.
Interrupt prioritization — assert multiple sources; verify IIR reports highest.
DDIS direction signal — LOW only during CPU reads from UART.
DMA Mode 0 vs Mode 1 (TXRDY / RXRDY pin behavior).
